templates.name: Create shipment from Zapier webhook
templates.description: Catch a Zapier webhook and create a Porterchain same-day shipment.
setup_steps: Generate a Porterchain API key with shipments:write
In Zapier, add Webhooks by Zapier → Catch Hook
Add Webhooks POST to Porterchain API URL with Authorization: Bearer pk_...

templates.name: Slack alert on delivery
templates.description: Post to Slack when Porterchain marks an order delivered.
setup_steps: Register Porterchain webhook for order.delivered pointing to Zapier catch URL
Map tracking_number and dropoff.formatted to Slack message

templates.name: NetSuite row → Porterchain shipment
templates.description: Map a spreadsheet or NetSuite export row to the NetSuite sync endpoint.
setup_steps: Use merchant portal session or API key for auth

templates.name: Email customer on tracking update
templates.description: Send Gmail when Porterchain emits order.tracking_updated.
setup_steps: Connect Gmail and map tracking URL
